title: Preflight Check
description: A script that checks every local asset before the offline stage and never downloads anything.

steps.description: The header comment says this checks every local asset before the offline stage and never downloads anything. It imports `importlib.metadata`, `sys`, and `requests`, pulls the config with `CFG`, and defines the `PINNED` package versions the tutorial was tested with.
Loop over the pinned packages and compare the installed version to the wanted one. A mismatch or a missing package appends a message to `problems` instead of raising.

Ask Ollama for its model tags with `GET /api/tags`, build the set of available names, and check that both the embed model and the chat model are present. If Ollama cannot be reached, the code records a message naming the error and suggesting `ollama serve`.
If any problem was collected, print `PREFLIGHT FAILED` with each message and exit with status 1. Otherwise print that preflight is ok: packages pinned, Ollama local, both models present.
